title: Newall Telescope Observatory
scope: The standing marble Newall Telescope Observatory at Penteli, its attached southern approach, and the historic refractor visible behind the open dome shutter.
limitations: The permanent observatory footprint, crown diameter and general instrument form are grounded in primary evidence. Eave heights, exterior openings, dome shading and shutter framing are approximate.

The historic refractor is posed behind an open shutter and shown as a static visual reconstruction. Fine optical mechanics, the movable floor mechanism and surrounding campus buildings are outside scope.
The approach follows the mapped southern footprint, with simpler stair and pavement geometry over the original hill elevation.
